ella_support: hey team, customer reported our structured_output (JSON mode) parser throwing "Invalid JSON" on what looks like a perfectly valid schema response. they pasted output, see below. suspecting schema validator mismatch or model producing HTML when a billing threshold hit. sam_eng: can you paste minimal repro & the exact response body? also which model + sdk version? ella_support: model=redwood-open-7b, SDK=py-2.3.1. customer said it started after they hit a quota alert earlier today. pasted body: ``` Payment Required

402 Payment Required

Your account exceeded free tier

``` ben_ml: ohhh that explains it — parser expects raw JSON but we sometimes return non-JSON error pages from the API gateway when billing/auth fails. pydantic/zod then raise opaque parse errors. the validator stack masks the original http status. maria_product: customer-facing we should surface a clearer error rather than "Invalid JSON". is this a bug in the SDK or the gateway? sam_eng: gateway returned 200 with HTML body for that request? that would be the root cause. if gateway returns 402 but proxy normalizes to 200 when streaming, SDK tries to parse JSON and fails. i need request id/logs. @ella_support can you send request_id from their call? ella_support: request_id=rx-2026-03-01-9a3f. logged it. customer also included their prompt snippet and a tiny repro curl: ```bash curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/respond \ -H 'Authorization: Bearer REPLACE_TOKEN' \ -d '{"model":"redwood-open-7b","input":"Generate JSON: {\\\"id\\\": 1, \\\"name\\\": \"acme\"}" , "mode":"json"}' ``` response they saw (raw): ``` HTTP/1.1 200 OK Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8 ...Payment Required HTML... ``` ben_ml: two problems we commonly see: 1) non-JSON error pages (billing, auth) returned with 200/streamed content, 2) model-returned extra text around JSON (prefix/suffix, markdown fences, trailing commas). pydantic is strict by default and will error with little context. zod gives path errors but also not always helpful. zod-bot: zod error example from a local repro: "ZodError: Invalid type at items.0.id: expected string, received number" — caused by schema allowing string ids but model sometimes emits numeric ids. sam_eng: mitigation plan: 1) SDK update to detect non-json content-types and bubble up HTTP status+body as structured SDK error (do not attempt schema validation). 2) add a lightweight pre-parse detector that checks for HTML tags or common error fragments (eg: "Payment Required", "403 Forbidden"). 3) provide a helper `repair_json(output)` that strips surrounding text and attempts to extract the first JSON object. 4) short term: update docs to recommend tolerant schemas (allow null or coerce types) when using model outputs. maria_product: agree. also add a clearer customer-facing error message: "Provider error: billing/auth issue — see account center" when content looks like html/error page. ella_support: here's a suggested `repair_json` snippet we can include in support replies: ```python import re, json def repair_json(s): # find first {...} block naive heuristic m = re.search(r"(\\{[\\s\\S]*\\})", s) if not m: raise ValueError("no JSON found") candidate = m.group(1) # try a few common fixes candidate = candidate.replace(',,', ',') candidate = candidate.replace(',\\n}', '\\n}') return json.loads(candidate) ``` ben_ml: that heuristic is fine for support notes but brittle for prod. longer-term we should add an opt-in "lenient_json_mode" to SDK that runs a small suite: strip fences, fix trailing commas, coerce numeric<->string when schema allows. also ensure we surface original http status. sam_eng: raised infra ticket to check gateway behavior: looks like a recent edge release changed error handling for quota responses. deploy-bot: deploy id `edge/2026-03-01-rollback` shows the related change. deploy-bot: rolled back edge release candidate for quota handling at 1769804000. maria_product: action items: support doc update + SDK patch + infra rollback confirmation. assign owners? sam_eng: i'll own infra + gateway fix. ben_ml will add lenient parse helpers to SDK, maria will update docs, ella will follow up with customer and provide repair snippet. ella_support: thanks all. i've messaged customer with interim workaround (repair snippet) and escalated billing case. :thumbsup:
